g.text: Identify the parts of the flower

Flowers have parts that help plants

— tap any tile to place it
• Petals are the colourful parts that attract pollinators.
• Sepals are the green leaf-like parts that protect the bud.
• The stamen is the male part: anther + filament.
• The pistil is the female part: stigma + style + ovary.
• The ovary is the swollen base that becomes fruit.
• The receptacle is the thickened stem that holds the flower.
Tap a tile in the word bank to see where it belongs.
Petal — colourful part that attracts pollinators
Sepal — green leaf that protects the bud
Filament — thin stalk holding the anther
Style — tube connecting stigma to ovary
Stigma — sticky top that catches pollen
Receptacle — base that supports all flower parts
